modules.title: Security Operations Centre
modules.summary: Command-centre dashboard: event volume, severity distribution, timelines, suspicious logins, endpoint and network telemetry.
features: Event timeline and alert distribution charts
Filter by severity, event type, date range and status
Suspicious login and endpoint activity panels
Network traffic and system health panels

modules.title: Threat Intelligence Centre
modules.summary: Threat actor, ransomware, malware and phishing campaign profiles with defanged IOCs and cited public reporting.
features: Ten actor and campaign profiles mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
Every fact cited with source, publication date and link
Simulated, defanged IOC watchlist with CSV export
Source-report index and Markdown profile export
Optional live lookups via serverless proxy (Phase 9)

modules.title: Attack Intelligence Library
modules.summary: Fourteen attack dossiers, each with methodology, a documented real-world incident, ATT&CK mapping, log sources, detections and response steps.
features: Verified fact vs analytical interpretation labelling
Cross-links to detections and incident playbooks

modules.title: Incident Response
modules.summary: Interactive case studies from identification to lessons learned, with evidence logs and a step-by-step investigation.
features: Six investigation scenarios with sample logs

modules.title: SIEM & Log Analysis
modules.summary: Searchable sample log datasets with in-browser parsing, normalisation and correlation demonstrations.
features: Windows Security, Sysmon, PowerShell, Linux auth, firewall, DNS, web and EDR logs
Parser lab: raw → extracted → normalised → enriched

modules.title: Detection Engineering
modules.summary: Searchable Sigma rule library with ATT&CK mapping, false-positive guidance and investigation notes.
features: Live evaluation against the simulated logs

modules.title: Vulnerability & CVE Intelligence
modules.summary: CVE intelligence built from CISA KEV and NIST NVD snapshots with clear freshness timestamps.
features: CISA KEV + NVD CVSS + FIRST EPSS snapshot

modules.title: Network Security Intelligence
modules.summary: Traffic-flow visualisations, segmentation and Zero Trust reference architectures, IDS/IPS concepts.
features: Segmentation vs Zero Trust simulator using the incident attack paths
Packet explorer with real bytes and verified checksums
Ten topic briefs with NIST, CISA and RFC references

modules.title: Security Tools Directory
modules.summary: Categorised directory of SIEM, EDR, IDS, forensics and cloud security tools with official documentation links.
features: Practical use cases and links to practise in Sentinel X

modules.title: Knowledge Centre
modules.summary: Searchable knowledge base and structured learning pathways for SOC, detection and incident response roles.
features: Five learning pathways with hands-on tasks
